description:
"Any cafe jobs in Shibuya?" "Find me a cafe job" — find answers to these questions just by chatting.

Mention an area or job type, and matching listings appear as cards right in the chat. You can also specify detailed conditions like hourly rate or work schedule through conversation.

・Search for jobs by describing your preferences
・Browse matching listings as carousel cards
・View job details on Baitoru

Tap the details button on any card to view more and apply on Baitoru.

※ This app targets job listings in Japan only.
※ Baitoru Terms of Service and Privacy Policy apply.
